"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"New technologies will allow the creation of new job-producing industries and save jobs in industries that have long been staples of America's economy.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The $2 billion commitment for clean coal research and development helps keep America's coal industry strong and reduces the emissions associated with coal use.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support FutureGen, an international, public-private initiative to build the world's first integrated sequestration and hydrogen research power plant that would burn coal more cleanly.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Bush's Clear Skies Initiative would create a $50 billion private market to deploy clean coal technologies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party supports research and investment designed to realize the benefits of a hydrogen economy and put the United States on the cutting edge of energy technology.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The FreedomCar Partnership and Hydrogen Fuel Initiative include $1.7 billion over five years to begin building hydrogen cars and the infrastructure to support them.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
